text:
sam: Drafting the benchmark narrative for launch — trying to make the latency vs cost story intuitive for product folks and buyers. sharing a quick sketch, pls rip it apart.

margo: sending it now, thx. main ask: which 2 visuals do we land on for the press/outbound? heatmap vs line charts?

sam: leaning heatmap (tokens/sec cost density) + small multiples for tail latency percentiles. heatmap shows unit economics, small multiples show predictability.

ian: +1 to small multiples. also include a simple legend that maps workload types to slices: chat (short), assistant (mid), summarization (long). keeps it concrete.

priya: for messaging, can we say "predictable latency at 10x lower unit cost vs raw GPU inferencing"? need to be careful with claims. maybe "up to 10x" and include a footnote defn of baseline.

sam: good call. propose copy: "Up to 10x cost improvements and consistent 95th percentile latency across standard LLM workloads (see slices). Baselines: unoptimized v100 single-card serving."

elaine: webinar hook idea: demo live routing — show same prompt routed to fast path vs slow path, and show cost diff and tail effects. short 5-min demo + 20-min Q&A.

ian: routing demo + ask the audience to pick which workload they care about (webinar poll). drives follow-ups / inbound segmentation.

margo: for outbound: 1) short kickoff post with 2 visuals (heatmap + one percentiles), 2) gated deep-dive with full methodology and config files, 3) webinar registration CTA in both. routing: tag leads who download deep-dive as "bench-engaged" and route to AE SDR queue.

sam: pipeline question — what metadata do we capture on the gated asset? required: company size, infra (hosted/dedicated/private), primary use-case. optional: latency sensitivity slider.

priya: agree. add a checkbox for "interested in Dedicated" — will help prioritize AE outreach.

benchbot: benchmark-report-v1.pdf uploaded to drive: https://rdw.in/bench-v1 (auto)

margo: chart asks for design: can design make heatmap rows be workload slices and columns be avg tokens? color scale anchored to $/1000 tokens to be customer-friendly.

sam: yes. also annotate where caching/batching yields the biggest wins so it doesn't look magical. add callout: "cacheable prefixes reduce per-token cost by up to 60% for assistant flows".

ian: for claims, add an appendix with test harness: model versions, batch sizes, quantization, hardware. we can't use ambiguous terms.

elaine: copy options for CTA: A) "See the numbers — register" B) "How much could you save?" (interactive calculator). Which performs better?

margo: do both. card A for awareness, card B for mid-funnel conversion. interactive calc gated so we capture email.

sam: action items: 1) margo: final visuals (heatmap + 95/99 small multiples) by Tue EOD, 2) ian: draft appendix methodology + poll question, 3) priya: copy safe-phrasing + CTAs, 4) elaine: webinar demo flow + demo assets, 5) benchbot: publish PDF link and attach raw CSVs.

priya: I'll run copy through legal quick-check, pinging @legal in the morning.

margo: ok moving to design thread, will post variant comps. :sparkles:

sam: thanks all — posting a short deck after stand for quick review.
